description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka- Issuance of Certificate of Exemption 06 Companies
reasoning: This gazette contains a legal/regulatory notice issued by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under Section 10(3) of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (Amended). It involves the issuance of certificates of exemption from licensing requirements for electricity distribution and supply, which constitutes regulatory action under existing legislation. The content focuses on legal exemptions and regulatory compliance rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
